arsenic.district_selection_rationale: Purposive: balances geographic coverage, national importance, sample count and censoring burden. Rajshahi carries an explicit high-censoring warning.
arsenic.primary_fit: left-censoring-aware (reverse Kaplan-Meier) empirical CDF + CDF least squares
arsenic.objective_region_rationale: Decision 9.1 variant V2: the reverse-KM curve is flat at height F_hat_0 (the censored mass) for every x below the smallest detected value, and cumulative_density_ opens with a placeholder point at x=0. Those plateau points carry no shape information about the fitted density and the placeholder actively pulls the fit, so the CDF least-squares objective uses only the points strictly above the initial mass.
